summary: The diff adds two new files cleanly (ai-os/audits/reporting_module_reaudit_2026-07-27.md and an ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml registration, both well-formed and internally consistent) but the core deliverable -- 'PROGRESS.md properly reconstructed' -- is not actually correct. Verified by reading the full resulting PROGRESS.md and cross-checking against real git log/commit content: at least two pairs of '# PROGRESS -- <task-id>' section headers have their content swapped with each other, and two tasks' real progress logs are entirely missing from the file (replaced by wrongly-labeled content from other tasks). This defect was introduced on this same branch's own reconstruction commit (88345186, 'fix: reconstruct PROGRESS.md correctly'), which is part of this diff's ancestry, so it is this PR's responsibility even though the doubled-header pattern for the first pair partially predates it on main. Since the whole point of this task was an accurate historical/audit-trail document (AGENTS.md Rule 7(d) traceability), shipping it in a scrambled state defeats the task's own purpose despite being a docs-only, tier1-classified, low-blast-radius diff.
issues: PROGRESS.md:83-136 -- header at line 83 ('# PROGRESS -- task-20260727-122632-projexa-e2e--hierarchical-boq-breakdown') is immediately followed by a second header at line 84 ('# PROGRESS -- task-20260727-101145-reporting-api-gateway--external-ai-scope') with zero content of its own; the content that follows (lines 86-136, 'Root-caused the bug: buildProductNodes()...', ending in PR #607) is actually the fix-veri-erp-product-chain-bug task's log (matches header at line 1, which is itself empty), not the reporting-api-gateway task's log.

PROGRESS.md:266-374 -- header at line 266 ('# PROGRESS -- task-20260727-093117-fix-dependabot-alert34-sharp-cve', a Sharp/CVE dependency-fix task) is followed by content that is entirely about hierarchical BoQ line items, interim billing, and Excel BoQ import (constructionBoqLineItems, computeHierarchicalAmount(), constructionInterimBills, PR #596) -- this is the projexa-e2e--hierarchical-boq-breakdown task's log (header at line 83, which is empty), not the dependabot/Sharp CVE task's log.

The real progress logs for task-20260727-101145-reporting-api-gateway--external-ai-scope (the PR #601 csvEscape/CSV-injection fix) and task-20260727-093117-fix-dependabot-alert34-sharp-cve (the Sharp CVE fix) do not exist anywhere in the reconstructed PROGRESS.md -- their headers exist but point at the wrong content, and their own real content is nowhere in the file.

Within the line-84 section, the '## Completed' content (product-chain-bug fix) and the '## Remaining' content ('STRICT_TENANT_ISOLATION is the Owner's top concern', a curl-example TODO) belong to two different, unrelated tasks glued under one header -- confirms this is a genuine content-splicing bug in the reconstruction, not just a duplicate-header cosmetic issue.
